data.description: When the wormhole appears at the start of a wave it should appear somewhere well away from the current (and future based on current trajectory) position.
data.title: Wormhole appears away from player

data.description: When enemies spawn in at the start of a wave they should emerge from the center of the wormhole and move to their starting position. The speed at which this happens should match the current period in which they cannot be hit.
data.title: Enemies should emerge from the wormhole
